description: Optional repo-local agent skills for provider choice and structured evidence preparation. These files are not runtime inputs.

provider_policy.zero_config_behavior: Use public/yfinance-compatible data only when the user accepts zero-config public data or a demo command explicitly requests fixtures.
provider_policy.low_timeframe_preferred_provider: IBKR when explicitly selected and runtime health is ready.
provider_policy.crypto_policy: Ask the user to choose exchange/provider. Do not silently default generic consumer workflows to Binance.
fail_closed_when: timeframe does not match the requested factor

skills.purpose: Provider choice and fail-closed guard before live, low-timeframe, Auto-Quant, or factor-training work.
Macro liquidity and cross-asset stress context as structured regime evidence.
Options chain, implied vol, skew, gamma wall, and 0DTE pressure context as structured evidence.
ICT/SMC market-structure evidence such as BOS, CHoCH, order blocks, fair value gaps, premium/discount, and liquidity sweep context as structured evidence.

excluded_raw_sources.reason: Hard-coded provider endpoint/API key and exclusive provider mandate conflict with consumer choice.
Installer, hooks, scripts, local cache gates, A-share stock-analysis assumptions, and optional tunnel behavior are too broad for ict-engine runtime intake.
Managed-agent deployment, vendor MCP connectors, Microsoft 365 tooling, and document authoring are outside this repo's runtime boundary.
Promotional footers, broad web-search instructions, and recommendation language were removed in favor of structured fail-closed evidence.

Useful ICT/SMC structural taxonomy and freshness discipline, but the raw install flow depends on Mobius API calls, local embeddings/index build, Playwright downloads, and chart/image workflows outside ict-engine runtime boundaries.
